history.summary: A $1.0M / $1056 PSF 3BR in Tiong Bahru (D03) is implausibly cheap — prime D03 condos transact well above $2,000 PSF — pointing to a walk-up / old apartment block, a leasehold with very short remaining lease, or an incomplete listing. The score_1000 of 759 is an artifact of that abnormally low PSF and should not be trusted at face value.
history.rating_rationale: The headline numbers don't add up: $1056 PSF in Tiong Bahru is roughly half the going condo rate, built_year is null, and there is zero URA data. This is almost certainly a small old walk-up apartment (Seng Poh Lane is the Tiong Bahru pre-war/SIT estate area), not a liquid condo. The 759 technical score is purely a cheap-PSF artifact. Location (Tiong Bahru, Havelock TEL) is genuinely strong, but the unit is too opaque and likely too lease-impaired or character-restricted to underwrite confidently as an investment.

history.summary: A 1937 pre-war Tiong Bahru SIT conservation walk-up — a niche heritage asset, not a standard condo. The 'very_low_psf' cheapness is unverifiable: zero transaction data, regional-baseline appreciation, and null premiums across the board.
history.rating_rationale: This is not an investment-grade condo for a 5-7yr hold; it is a conserved pre-war walk-up (built ~1937) in the Tiong Bahru SIT estate. The dossier flags it as cheap (very_low_psf, $1,056 psf) but has NO basis: appreciation_txns=0, appreciation_source=regional_baseline (3.7% default), age_adj_premium=null, psf_premium_vs_cohort=null, built_year=null. Per the v3.4 prior, a very_low_psf flag with no comparable transactions is a data gap to distrust, not a confirmed bargain. Practical risks are heavy: no lift (walk-up), conservation restrictions on renovation, ambiguous/short remaining lease (many SIT flats have ~50-70yrs or are 99-yr from the 1930s-60s), and an illiquid, idiosyncratic resale market. Heritage charm can command a premium with the right owner-occupier, but as a yield/appreciation play the case is unverified and the exit is thin. Avoid for investment.
